latest_features: Injector now has manual localhost proxy controls and can start the world-download proxy before injection
Minimap now uses a cached stone border, smaller border sizing, and cached terrain shading for much better high-resolution performance
Storage Radar is visible again across role tiers and Tracer is now a standalone Render module instead of an ESP sub-setting
World Render now samples terrain more smoothly, Scaffold adds Allow Jump, and ShulkerPreview uses cleaner row-aligned live container windows
ShulkMod now follows the new click-style craft output flow, and release DLL builds use stronger standard hardening flags
